_description: Deterministic signature -> candidate module map for the autoheal drafting step. draft_proposals.py picks at most `max_files` rule files, in this order: by_cmd_head (first word of the signature's cmd_head), then by_error_class. Only when both give nothing does it fall back to keyword matching against the module index. Hook-denial classes are listed in hook_denial_modules: those signatures never go to the model; code files an `issue` proposal that names the denying hook's module. A module resolves to modules/<module>/rules/<module>.md when that file exists, else to the module's rule files in path order.
